name: Northstar Trade — order to cash
description: Entirely fictional local trade company. All systems run on premises; product names describe illustrative COTS choices, not installed software or vendor integrations.

applications.name: Northstar Order Management
applications.description: Accepts sales orders, validates prices, reserves stock and coordinates fulfilment and invoicing.

applications.name: Northstar Trade Portal
applications.description: Business customer storefront and order-status portal.

applications.name: Sales CRM (SuiteCRM)
applications.description: On-premises CRM: customer accounts and sales opportunities.

applications.name: Finance ERP (Odoo)
applications.description: On-premises ERP: product prices, invoices and settlement records.

applications.name: Warehouse Management (ERPNext)
applications.description: Illustrative on-premises warehouse application: stock, picking and shipment confirmation.

applications.name: Sales Analytics (Apache Superset)
applications.description: On-premises sales reporting over the curated analytics warehouse.

infrastructure.name: Trade application cluster
infrastructure.description: On-premises Kubernetes runtime; illustrative deployment dependency, not a discovered cluster.

infrastructure.name: Operational PostgreSQL service
infrastructure.description: On-premises database service with separate application databases.

infrastructure.name: Packaged-application MariaDB service
infrastructure.description: Illustrative on-premises database service for the CRM and warehouse applications; catalogued using the MySQL-compatible platform.

infrastructure.name: Trade event broker
infrastructure.description: On-premises Kafka service carrying order and shipment events.

infrastructure.name: Trade virtual machine platform
infrastructure.description: On-premises virtual machines hosting packaged business applications.

logicalData.name: Customer account
logicalData.description: Logical trading account; not equivalent to a physical dataset.

logicalData.name: Product and price
logicalData.description: Logical sellable product and agreed list price.

logicalData.name: Sales order
logicalData.description: Logical customer order including header and lines.

logicalData.name: Shipment
logicalData.description: Logical outbound shipment and delivery status.

datasets.name: Customer accounts
datasets.description: Synthetic business accounts; no personal contact data.

datasets.name: Product price list
datasets.description: Synthetic catalogue with SEK unit prices.

datasets.name: Sales order headers
datasets.description: Order header, business account, status and placement date.

datasets.name: Sales order lines
datasets.description: Requested products and agreed quantity and price; one row per order line.

datasets.name: Order accepted events
datasets.description: Synthetic order acceptance events; event lineage describes the publishing transformation, not all application accesses.

datasets.name: Available inventory
datasets.description: Warehouse quantity on hand and reserved quantity.

datasets.name: Shipment confirmations
datasets.description: Shipment status for fulfilled sales orders.

datasets.name: Sales invoices
datasets.description: Synthetic invoice amounts excluding tax in SEK.

datasets.name: Daily booked sales
datasets.description: Daily sales by account and product, computed from order headers and lines joined to customer and product dimensions. Booked sales, not recognized revenue.

products.name: Trade Order Book
products.description: Order-management team's product for order status, order lines and accepted-order events. Contract: immutable order IDs; event IDs are distinct. Demo freshness target: 5 minutes.

products.name: Fulfilment Operations
products.description: Warehouse team's product for availability and shipment status. Demo freshness target: 15 minutes.

products.name: Sales Performance
products.description: Sales-data team's product for daily booked sales, dimensions and invoice reconciliation. Demo freshness target: next business day.

functions.name: Capture sales order
functions.description: Validate customer and capture requested order lines.

functions.name: Validate order pricing
functions.description: Check agreed prices and calculate order value.

functions.name: Reserve available stock
functions.description: Request reservation from the warehouse application.

functions.name: Coordinate fulfilment
functions.description: Release accepted order to the warehouse and track shipment.

functions.name: Request sales invoice
functions.description: Request invoice creation in the finance ERP after shipment.

functions.name: Provide order status
functions.description: Expose order state to the trade portal.
